non_claims: the sugar that carries the acyl group and the acyl position are not resolved
the aglycone and the acyl identity come from the hypothesis and are reported, not claimed; isomeric aglycone and acyl combinations share one precursor composition
p-coumaroyl and caffeoyl esters, and flavanone, dihydroflavonol, flavan-3-ol, chalcone and dihydrochalcone aglycones, are outside this rule

notes: Two ions jointly: the protonated aglycone of a flavone, flavonol or isoflavone glycoside hypothesis with one feruloyl or sinapoyl unit, and that acyl's acylium ion; flavanone-type aglycones are excluded because their B ring can give cinnamoyl-type ions.

competitors.note: non-acylated glucuronides lie 0.015 Da from feruloyl hypotheses of the same aglycone and share Y0; the hexuronic acid oxonium ion C6H9O6+ 177.0394 is 0.015 Da from the feruloyl acylium
B-type dimers C30H26O11 to C30H26O14 are exact isomers of aglycone|Pen1,feruloyl1 hypotheses; their fragments at the y0 and acylium targets were not checked against a source

source.locator: Results and Discussion, Fragmentation pathways of acylated flavone diglycosides; Table 2

source.reference: WS8-P3 protocol default floor, fixed before any data look (directive 2026-11-18; P2 default 0.01); kept where no paper prints a floor, provisional (WS0 2026-11-19, pending the author)

terms.note: [aglycone+H]+ after loss of all sugars and the acyl group (e.g. apigenin 271.0601, chrysoeriol 301.0707 in src:1); also src:2 for acylated isoflavone glucuronides
feruloyl acylium C10H9O3+ 177.0546, listed for [M+H]+ of acylated flavonoid glycosides in src:0
sinapoyl acylium C11H11O4+ 207.0652, listed for [M+H]+ of acylated flavonoid glycosides in src:0
